Task: A weather card for Berlin: it loads forecast.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temperature" in degrees Celsius and a text "condition"), shows "Berlin: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 15 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

Your program:
```
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temperature").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("condition").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(40, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Berlin: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temperature\":21,\"condition\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Berlin: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(
    update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temperature\":7,\"condition\":\"fog\"}"))),
    Got(parsed("[]"))
  ).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
